title: Notification menu
description: A bell that opens a list of recent notifications. It rings when a new one arrives.
iconsNote: The icons in this menu use the default Hover state, so any System Outline or System Solid icon will fit. Stick with the default animation, as In, Morph and Loop states don’t work well here.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The bell button
fragments.note: The bell rings when the count goes up.

fragments.title: Unread rows are the count
fragments.note: Opening the panel reads nothing. A click on a row, or Mark as read, does.

fragments.title: Show the count
fragments.note: Writes the attribute and draws the badge. Nothing here reaches for the icon.

fragments.title: One notification
fragments.note: An unread row gets its dot and tint from one attribute.

fragments.title: Start the tint with the row
fragments.note: Each row's tint arrives in step with the row.

fragments.title: The colour of a row
fragments.note: The tint grows across the row as it comes in.
